# G3: one four pin net (clique weight 1/3 per pair). B has its pin 0.5 mm to the right of its centre.
# The pin settles on the mean of the other three pins: x = (0+30+60)/3 = 30, y = (0+6+12)/3 = 6,
# so the centre of B is at (29.5, 6).
board 0 0 80 40
cell A 0 0 1 1 fixed
cell C 30 6 1 1 fixed
cell D 60 12 1 1 fixed
cell B 10 30 1 1 free
net n4 1 A C D B:0.5,0
expect B 29.5 6
